_comment: Non-English spellings of the SAME high-frequency people already listed in gazetteer_names.json (English), each paired with the SAME short_form already used there — this is what makes a Chinese/Russian/Polish mention of this person resolve to the identical canonical token entity_tokens() already emits for the English mention, closing the cross-lingual same-event-matching gap found 2026-09-06 (a Polish article and an English article about the literal same Witkoff/Kushner/Zelensky meeting were judged NO_OVERLAP because their entity tokens never matched). Confidence: zh_hans/zh_hant/ru drafted with high confidence (standard press transliterations); fa (Persian) deliberately left empty everywhere below — no independently-verified source for Persian transliteration, do not fill in without one. pl (Polish) is empty for anyone whose name is written identically to the English form in Polish text (true for nearly all CCP/US figures — Polish borrows pinyin for Chinese names and keeps Western Latin names unchanged), and filled in only for the handful of Slavic names Polish actually re-spells (Putin, Zelensky, Lavrov, Mishustin).

roles._comment: Reference only — NOT consumed by entity_tokens()/event matching. English-language role tag per person, for editorial/prompt reference.
roles.Xi Jinping: President of the PRC / CCP General Secretary
roles.JD Vance: Vice President of the United States
roles.Keir Starmer: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

role_terms_reference._comment: Multilingual glossary of the 6 role categories, per user's request — NOT wired into entity_tokens()/matching (a bare role word like '外交部长' shared between two articles about two different foreign ministers would cause false same-event merges if used as a matching token; GPT-4o-mini already understands these roles natively in every language when scoring/writing, so this table's real use is as an editorial/human reference, or a future building block if a different feature needs it). fa left empty, no verified source.
